title: PayPack AI Service Value Metadata
description: Standard schema for AI agents to evaluate service value before initiating payment. x402/AP2 defines HOW to pay; this schema defines whether the payment is WORTH IT.

service_id.description: Unique identifier of the service, using reverse-domain notation (e.g., com.weather.pro.v1)

version.description: Metadata schema version this file conforms to

description.description: Brief description of what this service does, optimized for AI agent comprehension

model.description: Pricing model: fixed price per call, tiered by volume, or dynamic based on usage

amount.description: Base price per call, in the smallest unit of the specified currency (e.g., cents for USD, wei for ETH)

estimated_total_cost.description: Estimated total cost including channel fees and gas. Provided by PayPack Cloud.

avg_latency_ms.description: Average latency in milliseconds over the last 24 hours

success_rate.description: Proportion of successful calls in the last 24 hours. 1.0 = 100% success.

p99_latency_ms.description: 99th percentile latency in milliseconds over the last 24 hours

accuracy_score.description: Output accuracy score, applicable for AI/ML APIs

data_freshness_sec.description: Maximum data staleness in seconds, for data APIs

trust_score.description: Composite trust score calculated by PayPack Cloud based on historical transaction data, dispute rate, and uptime. See specs/trust-score-methodology.md for the full calculation formula.

total_calls_24h.description: Total number of calls in the last 24 hours

dispute_rate.description: Proportion of transactions disputed in the last 30 days

uptime_pct.description: Uptime percentage in the last 30 days

refund_policy.description: Under what conditions refunds are granted

data_retention_days.description: How many days the service retains user data

support_response_h.description: Guaranteed support response time in hours

endpoints.description: List of API endpoints this service exposes

path.description: API path relative to service root
